Ranbir Kapoor's First Look from 'Love and War' Released

The first look of actor Ranbir Kapoor from the upcoming film 'Love and War' has been released. Kapoor is seen in an injured appearance in the poster. The film's release date is also mentioned. Actress Alia Bhatt reacted to the poster, calling Kapoor 'Hey Handsome' and describing his look as romantic.
